datasheet_identity.title: NTMFS5C430NL MOSFET - Power, Single, N-Channel, 40 V, 1.4 mOhm, 200 A

extraction_notes: The datasheet publishes VSD = 0.81 V typical and 1.2 V maximum at VGS = 0 V, IS = 50 A, TJ = 25 degC; the strict body_diode field records the typical value. At TJ = 125 degC, VSD typical is 0.68 V.

Body-diode reverse recovery is tRR = 61 ns typical and 77 ns maximum, with dIS/dt = 100 A/us and IS = 50 A; QRR is 80 nC typical and 92 nC maximum. These fields are not represented by the strict schema.

The datasheet capacitance table on p. 2 is in pF and uses the shared condition VGS = 0 V, f = 1 MHz, VDS = 20 V for CISS, COSS, and CRSS: CISS is 4300 pF typical (4.3e-9 F) and 4942 pF maximum (4.942e-9 F); COSS is 1900 pF typical (1.9e-9 F) and 2850 pF maximum (2.85e-9 F); CRSS is 72 pF typical (7.2e-11 F) and 144 pF maximum (1.44e-10 F). The catalog values 4.942 nF for Ciss and 144 pF for Crss match the datasheet maximum column under that same stated condition, so the apparent PDF/catalog difference is typical-versus-maximum source semantics rather than a documented alternate bias condition.
Thermal resistance is RthetaJC = 1.4 degC/W steady state and RthetaJA = 40 degC/W steady state, p. 1; these fields are not represented by the strict schema.

Curve points are manual reads from the supplied typical-characteristic plots. Figure 1 includes VGS curves from 2.6 V through 3.6 V to 10 V, and Figure 2 includes temperature curves at VDS = 5 V; selected traces are recorded.
omission_reason: The strict schema does not represent gate charge, switching, reverse-recovery, thermal, leakage, or safe-operating-area fields. Published output, transfer, and capacitance curves were available and recorded.
